We'll first list methods signatures:

- public static void notNull(Object obj)

- public static void isTrue(boolean val)

- public static void isFalse(boolean val)
- public static void isFalse(boolean val, String msg)
- public static void noNullElements(Object[] objects)

- public static void notEmpty(String string)

Edge cases: null objects, empty arrays, array with null, empty string, string with whitespace, boolean true/false combos, custom messages.

Test cases: For each method, one test that passes (no exception). Then tests that throws with default message (maybe check exception message). Also tests with custom message verifying message.

We'll include helper method to assert exception message using try-catch and fail.

But JUnit 4 can use ExpectedException rule to check message. Simpler: use @Test(expected=IllegalArgumentException.class) for just expecting, and separate test to capture message.

We'll create test methods like testNotNull_Pass, testNotNull_FailDefaultMessage, testNotNull_FailCustomMessage.

Similarly for other methods.

But requirement: identify edge cases and exception handling scenarios that should be tested. So include test for null array to ensure NPE occurs (maybe not expected but we can assert). We'll use expected NullPointerException.

For notEmpty, test with whitespace string (should pass because length >0). test with empty string and null.

For fail method, test that always throws IllegalArgumentException with given message.
